Variants.Content: The influence of the Santo family came from the trading society of Pentos. Ships were loaded and unloaded in the ports, caravans arrived from the eastern roads, and debts and news flowed among the mansions of the powerful. If Santo wants to be established for a long time, it must convince its partners that it will keep its promises even if it suffers losses, and avoid handing over generations of accumulation to pirates or wars in one big gamble. Pentos maintains superficial order by the prince and governor class, but its real power is often hidden in merchant houses, debts, marriages and mercenary contracts. The treaty with Braavos prohibited open slavery and limited armaments, but the wealthy still circumvented the rules with indentured servants and complicated names.
